_about: One recommended chat model and one image model per hardware tier (StarkLLM 2.7, model picker).
Read by the engine (backend/app/services/model_fit.py) and by the desktop app at first start (desktop/model-tiers.js).
To update: change a model name or a threshold here; every text model and image model named here must also be in
RECOMMENDED_MODELS (backend/app/services/llm_service.py) with its size on disk. The tests check both.
A tier applies when the PC has at least gpu_gb of video memory on a graphics card of its own (gpu tiers) or at
least ram_gb of memory (processor tiers, also for integrated graphics, which share the PC's memory).
The highest tier that applies wins.
